KAPITEL 2:

```{r}
prices_daily <- prices |>
    group_by(symbol) |>
    mutate(n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(n == max(n)) |>
    select(-n)
```

```{r}
returns_monthly <- prices_daily |>
    mutate(date = floor_date(date, "month")) |>
    group_by(symbol, date) |>
    summarize(price = last(adjusted_close), .groups = "drop_last") |>
    mutate(ret = price / lag(price) - 1) |>
    drop_na(ret) |>
    select(-price)
```

```{r}
assets <- returns_monthly |>
    group_by(symbol) |>
    summarize(
        mu = mean(ret),
        sigma = sd(ret)
    )
```

```{r}
#####
assets |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sigma, y = mu, label = symbol)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text_repel() +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Risk (Standard Deviation of Returns)",
        y = "Expected Return (Mean of Returns)",
        title = "Risk-Return Profile of Assets"
    )
#####
```

```{r}
returns_wide <- returns_monthly |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = symbol, values_from = ret)

sigma <- returns_wide |>
    select(-date) |>
    cov()
```

```{r}
#####
sigma |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "symbol_a") |>
    pivot_longer(-symbol_a, names_to = "symbol_b") |>
    ggplot(aes(x = symbol_a, y =fct_rev(symbol_b), fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL,
        fill = "(Co-variance)",
        title = "Covariance Matrix of Asset Returns"
    ) +
    scale_fill_continuous(labels = percent) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 15, barheight = 0.5))
#####
```

```{r}
iota <- rep(1, dim(sigma)[1])
sigma_inv <- solve(sigma)
omega_mvp <- as.vector(sigma_inv %*% iota) / as.numeric(t(iota) %*% sigma_inv %*% iota)
```

```{r}
assets <- bind_cols(assets, omega_mvp = omega_mvp)

#####
assets |>
    ggplot(aes(x = omega_mvp, y = fct_reorder(symbol, omega_mvp), fill = omega_mvp > 0)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Weights of Assets in the Minimum Variance Portfolio"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
#####
```

```{r}
mu <- assets$mu

summary_mvp <- tibble(
    mu = as.numeric(t(omega_mvp) %*% mu),
    sigma = as.numeric(sqrt(t(omega_mvp) %*% sigma %*% omega_mvp)),
    type = "Minimum-Variance Portfolio"
)
summary_mvp
```

```{r}
mu_bar <- max(assets$mu)
```

```{r}
C <- as.numeric(t(iota) %*% sigma_inv %*% iota)
D <- as.numeric(t(iota) %*% sigma_inv %*% mu)
E <- as.numeric(t(mu) %*% sigma_inv %*% mu)
lambda_tilde <- as.numeric(2 * (mu_bar - D / C) / (E - D^2 / C))
omega_efp <- as.vector(omega_mvp + lambda_tilde / 2 * (sigma_inv %*% mu - D * omega_mvp))

summary_efp <- tibble(
    mu = as.numeric(t(omega_efp) %*% mu),
    sigma = as.numeric(sqrt(t(omega_efp) %*% sigma %*% omega_efp)),
    type = "Efficient Portfolio")
```

```{r}
summaries <- bind_rows(
    assets, summary_mvp, summary_efp
)
#####
summaries |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sigma, y = mu)) +
    geom_point(
        data = summaries |> filter(is.na(type))
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = summaries |> filter(!is.na(type)), color = "#F21A00", size = 3
    ) +
    geom_label_repel(aes(label = type)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Risk (Standard Deviation of Returns)",
        y = "Expected Return (Mean of Returns)",
        title = "Efficient & minimum-variance portfolios"
    ) 
```

```{r}
efficient_frontier <- tibble(
    a = seq(from = -1, to = 2, by = 0.01),
) |>
    mutate(
        omega = map(a, \(x) x * omega_efp + (1 - x) * omega_mvp),
        mu = map_dbl(omega, \(x) t(x) %*% mu),
        sigma = map_dbl(omega, \(x) sqrt(t(x) %*% sigma %*% x)),
    )
```

```{r}
summaries <- bind_rows(
    summaries, efficient_frontier
)
#####
summaries |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sigma, y = mu)) +
    geom_point(
        data = summaries |> filter(is.na(type))
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = summaries |> filter(!is.na(type)), color = "#F21A00", size = 3
    ) +
    geom_label_repel(aes(label = type)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Risk (Standard Deviation of Returns)",
        y = "Expected Return (Mean of Returns)",
        title = "Efficient frontier from tickers"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
#####
```

KAPITEL 3:

```{r}
risk_free_monthly <- download_data(
    type = "stock_prices", symbol = "^IRX",
    start_date = "2016-01-01", end_date = "2024-01-01"
) |>
    mutate(
        risk_free = (1 + adjusted_close / 100)^(1 / 12) - 1
    ) |>
    select(date, risk_free) |>
    drop_na()

rf <- mean(risk_free_monthly$risk_free)
```

```{r}
sigma <- returns_monthly |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = symbol, values_from = ret) |>
    select(-date) |>
    cov()

mu <- returns_monthly |>
    group_by(symbol) |>
    summarise(mu = mean(ret)) |>
    pull(mu)
```

```{r}
w_tan <- solve(sigma) %*% (mu - rf)
w_tan <- w_tan / sum(w_tan)

mu_w <- as.numeric(t(w_tan) %*% mu)
sigma_w <- as.numeric(sqrt(t(w_tan) %*% sigma %*% w_tan))

efficient_portfolios <- tribble(
    ~symbol, ~mu, ~sigma,
    "omega[tan]", mu_w, sigma_w,
    "r[f]", rf, 0
)

sharpe_ratio <- (mu_w -rf) / sigma_w
```

```{r}
#####
assets |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sigma, y = mu)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_point(data = efficient_portfolios, color = "blue") +
    geom_label_repel(data = efficient_portfolios, aes(label = symbol), parse = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Risk", y = "Expected return",
        title = "The efficient frontier with a risk-free asset"
    ) +
    geom_abline(aes(intercept = rf, slope = sharpe_ratio), linetype = "dotted")
#####
```

```{r}
betas <- (sigma %*% w_tan) / as.numeric(t(w_tan) %*% sigma %*% w_tan)
assets <- assets |>
    mutate(beta = betas)

price_of_risk <- as.numeric(t(w_tan) %*% mu - rf)
#####
assets |>
    ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = mu)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(intercept = rf, slope = price_of_risk) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Beta", y = "Expected return",
        title = "Security market line"
    ) + 
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = rf, label = "Risk-#free")
#####
```

```{r}
factors <- download_data(
    type = "factors_ff_5_2x3_monthly",
    start_date = "2016-01-01", end_date = "2024-01-01"
) |>
    select(date, mkt_excess, risk_free)
```

```{r}
returns_excess_monthly <- returns_monthly |>
    left_join(factors, join_by(date)) |>
    mutate(ret_excess = ret - risk_free) |>
    select(symbol, date, ret_excess, mkt_excess)

estimate_capm <- function(data) {
    fit <- lm("ret_excess ~ mkt_excess", data = data)
    tibble(
        coefficient = c("alpha", "beta"),
        estimate = coefficients(fit),
        t_statistic = summary(fit)$coefficients[, "t value"]
    )
}

capm_results <- returns_excess_monthly |>
    nest(data = -symbol) |>
    mutate(capm = map(data, estimate_capm)) |>
    unnest(capm) |>
    select(symbol, coefficient, estimate, t_statistic)
```

```{r}
#####
capm_results |>
    filter(coefficient == "alpha") |>
    mutate(is_significant = abs(t_statistic) >= 1.96) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = fct_reorder(symbol, estimate), fill = is_significant)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
        x = "Estimated asset alphas", y = NULL, fill = "Significant at 95%?",
        title = "Estimated CAPM alphas"
    )
```
